source: Plugins.link('menu.dll');if(typeof global.Pad=='undefined')global.Pad=%[];if(typeof Debug.console=='undefined')Debug.console=%[];Plugins.link('windowEx.dll');var events=[],ready=false,phase=0,queried=false,veto=true;var w=new Window();w.registerExEvent();w.onMaximizeQuery=function(){global.queried=true;return global.veto;};w.maximize();function step(){if(phase==0 && queried){events.add(w.maximized);veto=false;w.maximize();phase=1;}else if(phase==1 && w.maximized){events.add(w.maximized+':'+w.minimized);w.minimize();phase=2;}else if(phase==2 && w.minimized){events.add(w.maximized+':'+w.minimized);w.showRestore();phase=3;}else if(phase==3 && !w.minimized){events.add(w.maximized+':'+w.minimized);w.showRestore();phase=4;}else if(phase==4 && !w.maximized){events.add(w.maximized+':'+w.minimized);ready=true;System.removeContinuousHandler(step);}}System.addContinuousHandler(step);
